```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggfortify)
```

# Load data 

```{r}
load("../../data/ZIGMM-model-output.rds")
load("../../data/phylum-labels.rds")
```

# Prep 

```{r}
colors <- c("cyan4", "darkgoldenrod2", "darkgreen", "salmon2", "cornflowerblue", "deeppink4") 

gmm.out <- gmm.out %>%
  left_join(phyl_labels) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(padj < 0.05, microbe, NA),
         Phylum = ifelse(padj < 0.05, Phylum, NA))
```

# Plot 

```{r}
gmm.out %>%
  filter(padj < 1,
         term == "ResponseResponder:Days") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=estimate, y=-log10(padj), label= label)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=estimate, y=-log10(padj), color = Phylum)) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, na.value = "honeydew3") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  xlab("Estimate") +
  ylab("log10(p-value)") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(na.translate = FALSE))

ggsave("../../figures/exploratory-ZIGMM-nonquad-volcano.png", height = 4, width = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
gmm.out %>%
  filter(padj < 1,
         term == "ResponseResponder:I(Days^2)") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=estimate, y=-log10(padj), label= label)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=estimate, y=-log10(padj), color = Phylum)) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 2) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, na.value = "honeydew3") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  xlab("Estimate") +
  ylab("log10(p-value)") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(na.translate = FALSE))

ggsave("../../figures/exploratory-ZIGMM-quad-volcano.png", height = 4, width = 7, dpi = 300)
```

Volcano plots are looking pretty sparse. Quadratic terms seem almost not worth 
showing, the estimate is so small. lets try a lollipop plot to highlight P. plebeius 

```{r}
gmm.out %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05,
         term == "ResponseResponder:Days") %>%
  arrange(estimate) %>%
  mutate(microbe = factor(microbe, levels = unique(microbe))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = microbe)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = estimate, y = microbe, yend = microbe), color = "grey") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ term, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Estimate (LMM)", y = "Microbe") 

ggsave("../../figures/exploratory-ZIGMM-nonquad-lolipop.png", height = 4, width = 7, dpi = 300)
```
